company_name: Hefei Accuracy Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Hefei Accuracy Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in ultra-precision material removal and process equipment specifically for semiconductor packaging.
summary: Hefei Accuracy Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on developing and manufacturing advanced equipment for semiconductor packaging, including dicing saws and wire bonders. The company aims to enhance the localization and technological advancement of packaging processes in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Dicing saws for precision dicing of semiconductor materials
Wire bonders for ball and wedge bonding processes

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Hefei with branch offices in Changsha and Shenzhen, and service outlets in Beijing, Shanghai, and Xi'an.
